stable.notes: A tidier menu-bar panel: the version card is gone, the refresh button at the top right also checks for updates, and the version shows next to Control. Updates still arrive as the gold banner. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. Pairs with server 6.67.0.

whatsNew.summary: A tidier menu-bar panel. The version card is gone, so Activity sits right under the header. The refresh button at the top right now also checks for updates, and the version shows next to Control.

sections.title: A tidier panel
items: The version card at the top of the panel is gone. Updates still arrive as the gold Update available banner.
The refresh button at the top right refreshes status and checks for updates in one click.
While it checks, the line under Control says Checking for updates, then Up to date, or Couldn't check for updates if it could not reach the update server.
The version shows next to Control, so you can see it without scrolling.
Settings in Activity has the same refresh and check button.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
